item.title: EplayerX 1.2.23
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 扩大弹幕滚动时长的调节范围，支持 2–30 秒，并可按 0.5 秒精细调整。 - 修复返回前台或同步未变化的设置时弹幕被重置的问题，改善弹幕显示的连续性，并减少退出播放时的残留弹幕。 - 改善 PGS 图形字幕切换，优先使用已缓存的字幕数据，减少切换语言时对音视频播放的打断。 - 改善部分杜比视界视频的播放兼容性：当符合条件的片源缺少必要的杜比视界数据时，使用 HDR10 基础画面播放。 - 修复多个任务同时下载时，下载速度采样可能受其他任务干扰的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Expanded the danmaku scrolling duration range to 2–30 seconds, with finer 0.5-second adjustments. - Fixed danmaku resets when returning to the app or syncing unchanged settings, improving continuity and preventing leftover comments when exiting playback. - Improved PGS image subtitle switching by reusing cached subtitle data, reducing interruptions to audio and video when changing languages. - Improved compatibility with certain Dolby Vision videos by playing the HDR10 base layer when eligible sources lack required Dolby Vision data. - Fixed download speed sampling being affected by other tasks when multiple downloads run simultaneously.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
